headline: As of 2026-10-31: 52,187,072 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 52,187,072 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,368,274), California (5,226,574), Florida (4,827,790).
